title: Hermes transform_llm_output Hook
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 transform_llm_output plugin hook. Fires post-LLM, cannot inject clinical labels, and logs results.

hook_id.description: Unique identifier for this hook invocation.

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the hook execution.

llm_call_id.description: Reference to the LLM call this hook is processing.

hook_timing.description: When the hook fires in the LLM pipeline.

intercepts_output.description: Whether hook intercepts the LLM output.

input_preserved.description: Whether the original input was preserved (hook cannot remove safety constraints).

input_hash.description: Hash of the input for audit purposes.

clinical_labels_injected.description: Whether clinical labels were attempted to be injected.

output_hash.description: Hash of the output for audit purposes.

safety_constraints_preserved.description: Whether safety constraints remain intact after transform.

clinical_labels_injected.description: Whether clinical labels were found in the output.
